objective: Global complete-sequence alignment with the stated generic affine-gap score. A gap of lengthl>=1has score open+(l-1)*extend, including terminal gaps. Double-gap columns are not allowed. These short abstract fragments are supplied as an annotation-coordinate example, not a homology or functional prediction.
mapping_scope: Consider EVERY globally maximum-score alignment, not just one alignment returned by a library. For each nominated reference site report every possible query residue position (one-based)and whether that reference residue can instead align to a gap in any optimum. Exact sequence character equality alone does not fix an annotation inside a repeat.
reporting: Possible-position arrays contain distinct sorted integers. Number of optimal alignments counts distinct gap placements, not program tie-order or identical textual formatting. Do not interpret a missing mapped residue as query position0.

provenance.data_origin: Explicit small controlled benchmark models, sequences and traits; no empirical evolutionary, functional or conservation-outcome claim.
